title: CMTV Trends: Sport TV Renewal and AI Integration
description: Recent reports indicate CMTV has renewed a broadcasting agreement and is integrating artificial intelligence into its programming.

sections.heading: Broadcasting Agreement
paragraphs: According to Correio da Manhã, CMTV has renewed an agreement with Sport TV regarding League games.

sections.heading: Artificial Intelligence Integration
paragraphs: Record reports that 'Relatos' on CMTV will feature new graphics, social media elements, and artificial intelligence.
Additionally, Infocul states that CMTV is reinforcing the 'Golos' segment with artificial intelligence and a new focus on live reports.

sections.heading: Search Interest
paragraphs: Google Trends data indicates that the term 'cmtv' has a search volume lower bound of 500 in the PT region as of August 2026. Google Trends analyzes the popularity of search queries across various regions and languages.

faq.a: According to Correio da Manhã, CMTV has renewed an agreement with Sport TV for League games.

faq.q: How is CMTV using artificial intelligence?
